# picoCTF

> > picoCTF is Carnegie Mellon University's free cybersecurity education platform featuring Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions, picoGym practice challenges, and comprehensive learning resources for students and educators.

Developed by CMU's CyLab Security and Privacy Institute, picoCTF provides hands-on cybersecurity training through gamified challenges covering cryptography, binary exploitation, web security, forensics, and reverse engineering. The platform serves beginners through advanced learners with year-round practice environments and annual competitions.
